metadata.attribution: Adapted from Statistics Canada, 2021 Census cartographic boundary files, 2021. This does not constitute an endorsement by Statistics Canada of this product.
metadata.method: 2021 Statistics Canada cartographic dissemination blocks clipped to the 2021 Richmond CSD. Each block is assigned to the planning area with its largest intersection; only the resulting membership facts and public census geometry are retained, not municipal polygon coordinates. East Richmond / Fraser Lands retains separate income-area membership facts. Coordinates rounded to seven decimal places. No population or income values are calculated from these geometries.

excludedBlocks.reason: No overlap with any referenced planning area; no neighbourhood assignment is inferred.
